_comment: Directed onboarding wizard for first-run ChiSurf configuration. Rendered by AutoForm from BoardingViewModel — no hardcoded Qt. Steps embed the FCS/detector editors via the general 'embed' custom section so they are attached in-place instead of floating.

steps.title: Welcome
steps.subtitle: A quick guided setup for a new ChiSurf installation.

buttons.label: 📂 Open settings folder
buttons.description: Open the user settings folder (~/.chisurf) in your file manager.

steps.title: Settings
steps.subtitle: Review your user settings files; open the editor when needed.

buttons.label: ✏️ Open settings editor
buttons.description: Open the ChiSurf settings editor to adjust paths and options.

steps.title: Fix / Initialize
steps.subtitle: Create missing settings files or restore packaged defaults.

buttons.label: ➕ Create missing files
buttons.description: Only writes settings files that do not exist yet.

buttons.label: ♻️ Restore defaults (overwrite)
buttons.description: Replace current user settings files with packaged defaults.

steps.title: Experiments
steps.subtitle: Update experiment/model configuration so new models appear.

buttons.label: 🔁 Update experiments
buttons.description: Re-sync experiment_configs.yaml from the packaged default so new fitting models (e.g. the AutoForm PDA models) show up. Requires a restart.

steps.title: Dependencies
steps.subtitle: Check optional Python packages used by specific features.

steps.title: Detector setup
steps.subtitle: Configure PIE / channel windows for TTTR workflows.

steps.title: FCS channels
steps.subtitle: Define which channels/pairs to correlate for FCS workflows.

steps.title: Finish
steps.subtitle: You are ready to start working.

buttons.label: ❓ Open Help
buttons.description: Browse experiment-specific guides and built-in documentation.
